eligibility.reason: E1/E4: a public report gives the consumer include sites and a compiler diagnostic. E2: compressed_depth_image_transport references a header supplied by the separately released cv_bridge library; the provider changed the preferred header name, so updating the include is an interface adaptation, not merely a build-system change. E3: UPGRADE is supported by continued use of the earlier header against the newer provider.
eligibility.quote: Build failure due to deprecated header. Should change ``cv_bridge.h`` to ``cv_bridge.hpp``.
